text: Could not establish whether contradicted is a lifecycle state or a fourth Kind. Claim.Kind already holds undetermined, which means the agent could not establish something and proceeded; SpanVerdict holds unclaimed, unverified, clear and acknowledged; there is no lifecycle-state field to extend. Written as a new state because the hand-off proposed one, recorded as DECISION-2 because the alternative is a much smaller change that would not touch PAWL-001's shape at all
